caption: The drawing displays a detailed design for a decorative ceramic piece, showing its components and illustrated scenes. At the center, there is a depiction labeled "Assembled" featuring a teapot-like vessel mounted on a cylindrical shaft set on a square pedestal; both the vessel and shaft are adorned with painted scenes including landscapes and buildings with smoke and fire. Above it to the left, there are diagrams labeled "Lid," "Top View of Shaft," and "Bottom (Shape) of Shaft," showing top and profile views in simple outline, including an ornamental border around the shaft. To the right of the assembled figure, there is a circular view labeled "Top View of Lid," displaying a rosette design, and a line drawing labeled "Pitcher showing base" providing the outline and a rear view of the vessel. At the bottom left is a painted rectangle labeled "Complete scene on Shaft," featuring a dramatic burning building with flames rising into a dark, smoke-filled sky, surrounded by trees and figures. To the bottom right is another rectangular painting labeled "Complete scene on Pitcher," showing a landscape with a large house, rocky foreground, and trees under a cloudy sky. The overall color palette includes greens, browns, yellows, reds, and grays, with the fire rendered in bright yellow, red, and orange tones, contrasting with the greens of the landscape and the grays and blacks of the smoke and sky.
title: Spirit Lamp with Teapot
